description: Stop syncing and discard the source configuration — its field mapping, schedule and sync cursor. RECORDS ARE NOT DELETED: every record the source ever created stays in the database, it simply stops being updated. The configuration itself is NOT recoverable, so `confirm` must equal the source's name exactly. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES delete_source"]

confirm.description: The source's exact name, as a guard against deleting the wrong one.

database.description: Database name, api slug, or id.

name: delete_source
title: Delete source
